ruling.recommended_action: Reject the rider's claim: the fare was a fixed RydeX quote (SGD 25.04) unaffected by the path taken, the trace matches the quoted polyline (no off-route segment), and there is no extra charge to refund. No account flag (driver's route-dispute record is clean).

rejected_claims.reason: Distance charged (10.761 km) equals the quote (10.761 km) and the GPS trace stays on the quoted polyline; moreover RydeX is a fixed-quote service, so no extra distance could be charged (RD-2 non-metered; FARE-1).
The 11 km figure matches the quote/actual distance of 10.761 km, so there is no unaccounted detour mileage (RD-1).
Driver's 'my GPS rerouted me' claim is immaterial: the trace shows the quoted route was followed and the fare is not distance-based; no off-route segment found (RD-1).
